newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks opened higher on Tuesday in a follow through to Monday's rally.
Traders said a steady bond market offered support and the Dow Industrials rose six to 7,014. The Nasdaq Composite rose five to 1,350, while the S&P Index was up fractionally at 810
The 30-year long bond was up 8/32 to yield 6.64 percent.
